Objects.name: ULSDVOBJ_EIGC_BLE_Key_v1
Objects.description: Commissioning secrets for the BMD-345 BLE module. Write-only on purpose - ULSBusConnection::cnProcessGetObject refuses a WRITEONLY object, so once these are in they cannot be read back over the bus by anyone, including ULS Tools. Written once at commissioning over a wired link, never over the air. See devs-nrf/RADIO.md

variables.name: fleetKey
variables.description: Fleet secret. The per-unit beacon key is CMAC(fleetKey, deviceSerial) and the service passkey is derived from the same pair, so this one write provisions both. Identical across every unit of a fleet; a unit whose fleetKey is all zero signs nothing and is rejected by every peer that has one

variables.name: keyEpoch
variables.description: Increments each time the fleet is rekeyed. A beacon carries the sender's epoch so a half-rekeyed fleet is diagnosable instead of merely silent: a peer that rejects everything can say whether the epochs disagree
